meta.note: Every id the release engine needs, as data (factory SSOT 8.6). A target is usable for a write only when it is filled AND confirmed. Values marked confirmed were read out of a working CMS tool in this repository (UNICON-TOOLS/HtmlToolLibraryItem - the HTML Tool Item Editor), not guessed, or were confirmed by the operator. confirmedParts records which parts of a target were confirmed when the whole target is still not writable.

objectExport.note: The operator can download the full folder and object list. When that file exists, a tool record id is resolved by matching the repository and tool-ideas slug against the export, never by generating an id. Expected shape: exportedAt, host, folders (id, name, typeId, parentId) and objects (id, cmsObjectType, typeId, name, slug, version). Until it exists every tool is reported unmatched and the tool target stays blocked.
